name: romanian-vocab-android
description: Android wrapper for the Romanian vocabulary web app.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:examples && npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk ./gradlew assembleDebug
